title: By the Light of the Silvery Moon

evidence.note: Wikipedia states the song, music by Gus Edwards and lyrics by Edward Madden, was published in 1909 by Jerome H. Remick & Co.
IMSLP catalog lists three 1909 first-edition printings (Gus Edwards Music Pub. Co. and Jerome H. Remick & Co.), confirming the 1909 publication year.

famous_use: By the Light of the Silvery Moon (1953 film), starring Doris Day, named after the song.
